title: Pudding — a calm baby food diary for starting solids
meta_desc: Pudding is a warm first-foods diary: log feedings and reactions, watch the observation window, and keep introduced allergens on schedule. No account — everything stays on your phone.
keywords: baby food diary, starting solids, first foods, weaning tracker, baby allergen tracker, food reaction log, blw tracker
og_title: Pudding — a calm baby food diary
og_desc: Log feedings and reactions, watch the observation window, keep allergens on schedule. Everything stays on your phone.
tw_desc: A warm first-foods diary. Everything stays on your phone.
hero_sub: Pudding quietly keeps track of feedings and reactions, shows the observation window, and reminds you to repeat introduced allergens on time. What and when to feed your baby — that's your call.
problem_h2: Starting solids is stressful. We get it.
problem_lead: What did we already try? Was there a reaction? When did we last give egg? Pudding keeps it all in one warm diary — instead of notes-app tables and 3 a.m. panic.
how_lead: Three simple habits — and the whole feeding story is at hand.

steps.p: A feeding, a "how it went" rating, a reaction, a note and photos — in a couple of taps.
Every new food goes through your plan's observation window — "day 2 of 3" right on the food card.
Pudding gently reminds you to repeat introduced allergens so tolerance isn't lost.

cards.p: 70+ foods with warm illustrations — plus your own custom foods when something's missing.
The observation window is set in your plan: separate for regular foods and allergens.
Gentle reminders to repeat introduced allergens — at the frequency from your plan.
A history feed with filters, a PDF for your pediatrician, a "do not give" sheet and a monthly recap.

screens_lead: A light cartoon theme, Pudding the mascot, and nothing extra.

shots.alt: Pudding home screen: today's diary and food collection
Food card with observation window, day 2 of 3
Calendar feed with filters and plans

privacy_h2: Your data stays on your phone
privacy_lead: No account, no ads, no tracking. Your baby's name, entries, photos and reactions are stored locally and never leave the device.
method_h2: The plan is yours. Pudding is the diary.
method_lead: Starting age, observation windows, allergen frequency and list — everything is configured to match your pediatrician's guidance. Pudding prescribes nothing and advises nothing: it carefully records and reminds on time.

faq.a: Yes, Pudding is free at launch.

faq.q: Do I need internet or an account?
faq.a: No. The app works offline, no sign-up — all data stays on your device.
No. It's a diary companion: it records and reminds. Agree on timing and decisions with your doctor.

faq.q: Where do the timings come from?
faq.a: They're not imposed: you set the starting age, observation windows and allergen frequency yourself in "your plan" — following your pediatrician's guidance.

faq.q: Is there an export for the doctor?
faq.a: Yes. A PDF with the feeding history, reactions and allergen status in a couple of taps — plus a short "do not give" sheet for the nanny or daycare.

footer.disclaimer: Pudding is a feeding diary, not medical advice. Make decisions about introducing foods and allergens together with your pediatrician.
